Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — excited to get Starlight live on Redwood. I've attached our completed onboarding packet and a line-item spreadsheet exported from our ERP. Two quick notes we flagged in the sheet:

- SKU A-123 appears twice in our export (different internal descriptions). We included both rows and flagged the preferred one in column H.
- We expect initial monthly spend to be ~ $18K, but legal has requested a provisional spend cap while we complete SOC validation.

Can you confirm next steps for a PO number (we need one for our AP) and whether you prefer us to resend a cleaned SKU list or if your procurement team can sanitize on your side?

Elaine — thanks for sending these over. Quick callouts:

1) I'll loop in Monica (procurement ops) to validate the SKU dedupe and create the PO. Monica — can you confirm we can issue a provisional PO while SOC2 evidence is in flight, and whether we should normalize SKU A-123 to the preferred description?

2) Markus from Legal — could you confirm if the provisional spend cap note is ok for a temporary PO or if Legal needs a different clause?

Elaine, we can provision a PO number for your AP to reference. If you can provide a cleaned CSV with the preferred SKU selected, we can avoid back-and-forth; but Monica can also run a quick normalization if you prefer.

Next step: Monica, can you draft a provisional PO (provisionally flagged as PENDING SOC) and share the number back to Elaine by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks Rishi — taking ownership. Quick procurement notes after reviewing the sheet:

- I cleaned the duplicate SKU rows and added a normalized_sku column; attached is the export (see column F for normalization flags).
- Proposed provisional spend cap: $20,000/month (rounding up to give a buffer). We will mark the PO as "Provisional - SOC evidence pending" in the description.
- Line-item correction: row 7 had a quantity unit of "EA" but pricing was listed per "LOT" — corrected to LOT with a line comment.

I'm not attaching the cleaned CSV in this thread for privacy; instead I've uploaded to our shared drive and linked it here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdExampleOnboardForm

Markus — for Legal: is language below acceptable for the provisional PO description? If not, propose edits.

"Provisional Purchase Order (PO RWI-7892) — provisional spend cap $20,000/month. Order valid while SOC2 evidence is pending; full contract terms to be executed following SOC validation. Redwood reserves right to pause provisioning if compliance requirements are not met"

If that's OK, I'll generate a provisional PO number and create the PO PDF (provisional_PO_RWI-7892.pdf) and share it with Elaine's AP. ETA: EOD today.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Monica / Rishi — language looks fine with one small tweak to make the remediation path clear. Suggested edit below (single-sentence replacement):

"Provisional Purchase Order (PO RWI-7892) — provisional spend cap $20,000/month. Order provisioning is subject to Starlight providing SOC2 Type II evidence within 60 days; Redwood reserves the right to suspend service or pause additional provisioning if evidence is not provided or remediation is required."

Monica — please generate the provisional PO using that text and include a short cover note to AP explaining the 60-day remediation window. Elaine — we'll attach the provisional PO PDF in a follow-up to your AP shortly; please confirm the AP email address to send to (we have procure@starlight.io on cc).

Thanks,
